request: LLM reply generation uses observation checkpoints and subjective progress/stop decisions, without fixed completion timeout.
scope: Complete changed source/diff and caller review; no fresh live-provider or browser generation acceptance.

sources.rationale: Explicit live-generation cases omit the local watchdog and emit durable observation checkpoints with actual child identity/log location. Timers do not judge model health. Existing local failure/timeout, source gate, prerequisite, live evidence admission and cleanup contracts retain their prior scope.

Live-only callback observations preserve actual available model text and tool events as JSON data while the existing complete capture and transport assertions remain unchanged. Event names are machine identifiers; model meaning is independently reviewed, never matched.

Real controlled child survives the supplied 1ms local limit, emits an opaque partial payload, waits for an atomic observer acknowledgment, then completes with exact supplied final bytes. Assert actual checkpoint persistence/PID and zero timeout. The fixture-only 5s watchdog cannot accept unfinished work. Full existing runner source and diff reviewed; no semantic literal oracle.
